edits.text: 1. PURCHASE PRICE. The Buyer shall pay the Seller USD [purchase price subject to client approval and agreement on valuation and any purchase-price adjustments] for the Shares (the “Purchase Price”). At Closing, the Buyer shall pay the Purchase Price by wire transfer of immediately available funds to an account designated in writing by the Seller, against delivery of the agreed instruments transferring the Shares. Buyer's payment obligation shall not be subject to a financing contingency. The treatment of any escrow, holdback or set-off remains subject to express agreement.

2. CLOSING. The parties shall target Closing within thirty days after signing. Closing shall be subject only to receipt of the regulatory approvals specifically listed in an agreed schedule and delivery of the customary closing deliverables specifically listed in this Agreement. Conditions may be waived in writing only by the party entitled to their benefit and only to the extent legally permissible. The parties shall agree an outside date, any extension required for outstanding regulatory approvals, and the consequences of failure to close by that date.

3. REPRESENTATIONS. The Seller represents that the financial statements identified in Schedule [Financial Statements] have been prepared in accordance with [agreed accounting standards], consistently applied, and fairly present in all material respects the Company's financial position and results for the dates and periods stated, subject to specifically identified exceptions in the disclosure schedules and agreed qualifications for any interim financial statements. The parties shall separately agree representations concerning title to the Shares, capitalization, authority and other transaction matters.

4. INDEMNITY. Subject to the definitions, limitations and procedures to be agreed, the Seller shall indemnify the Buyer for losses resulting from breaches of the Seller's representations, warranties and covenants and any specifically identified indemnified liabilities. For discussion only, general representation and warranty claims would survive Closing for twelve months, be subject to a deductible basket equal to 1% of the Purchase Price and an aggregate cap equal to 10% of the Purchase Price. A claim notified in reasonable detail before expiry of the applicable survival period shall survive until resolved. No double recovery shall be permitted. Matters fairly disclosed against a representation shall qualify that representation but shall not, solely by disclosure, exclude an expressly agreed specific indemnity. Treatment of title, authority, capitalization, actual fraud, covenants and specifically identified liabilities, including any separate survival periods and limits, remains to be agreed. Notice, defense, settlement, mitigation and recovery procedures remain to be agreed.

No price proposal is authorized by this draft. Obtain client instructions and supporting valuation materials before inserting a figure. Agree whether the transaction uses a fixed price, locked-box mechanism or closing accounts, and specify any debt, cash, working-capital and transaction-expense treatment.
